title: Clearer Settings and node connection checks
changes: Replace crowded Settings tabs with categorized desktop navigation while retaining the grouped mobile settings index.
Show how missing follower totals are supplemented by an indexed provider or saved cache; raw Snapchain does not supply aggregate follower counts.
Move compatible read fallback to a visible, clearly explained control without silently changing the primary read node.
Add on-demand API checks for all configured read nodes with per-node status, HTTP failures and response time.
Hide provider API-key entry until needed and distinguish live reader, pending selection and unsupported capabilities.
